design_preselection: All six Stage24 dates already used; this is a measurement repair, NOT independent out-of-sample strategy test.

source_contract.ground_truth: Existing six original SHA-verified Stage24 CI artifacts (all 758 cases each), official Binance publisher-verified monthly 1h outcomes
source_contract.minutely: Binance official daily Spot 1m ZIP+publisher SHA256 for contiguous 216h interval (24h warmup, 168h active replay, 24h exit prices), 10 daily archives needed; all 10 verified before one model poll; fail entire symbol-source on first missing day
source_contract.data_saving: If original monthly 168h GT is invalid, mark source_missing_or_gapped and do NOT claim any model negative/positive; skip additional 10 daily files as optimization; still keep all 758 symbol statuses in full-denominator output
source_contract.watch: Original V4 observe_snapshot and process_queue, unchanged 3m ticker-proxy polling based only on past 1m CLOSE with 24h rolling official quote volume and closed 5m bars
source_contract.first_poll: 06:03:00 UTC relative to frozen date 06:00 start, 3m poll at closed minute with same 24h-start initialization as Stage24
source_contract.last_poll: At or before 168h end exclusive, 3m cadence; same SQLite store retained over entire 168h for each individual symbol
source_contract.lookahead_for_classification_only: After WATCH emitted, official 1m FIRST HIGH crossing >= frozen 06:00 1h-open * 2/5/10 in future 168h; only labels when archived 168h complete
source_contract.source_ticker_limit: Binance historical actual full-market ticker and exchangeInfo cannot be reconstructed; use Stage24 same 1m closed-price + 24h quote rolling proxy. Zero-trade latest 1m poll retained for apples-to-apples original Stage24 baseline but marked proxy.
source_contract.queue_limit: One independent SQLite db per symbol for full168h; cross-symbol global queue limit8 and source latency are NOT represented. Report this limitation as possible optimistic timeliness.
source_contract.execution_proxy: Every original WATCH 3m delayed first minute-open entry, 24h price proxy with 10bps fee per side and 20bps,100bps slippage per side, requiring traded minute quotes and exit; enforce per-symbol non-overlapping 24h capital
source_contract.capital_model: Single 30USDT funding slot across all symbol-date WATCH candidates, deterministic sorted signal timestamp, no future-PnL ranking; reserve 24h for censored candidate
source_contract.signal_output: every watch timestamp and D1 setup timestamp, invalidation events, daily/rolling max alert count, 24h price return proxies, source hashes and cases

failure_policy: If too few full216h historical Spot 1m sources or source download fails, keep censorship and negative proof; don't silently call it no WATCH. Valid WATCH setup not imply BUY.
